name: open-webui
title: Open WebUI + Ollama
description: ChatGPT-style chat for local models: Open WebUI with Ollama, entirely on your hardware (no cloud, no API keys). Pick this server's graphics card on the deploy sheet (AMD through ROCm, NVIDIA) to run the models on it. The first account you create is the admin.

variables.name: PORT_OPEN_WEBUI
variables.label: Host Port
variables.description: Port to expose Open WebUI on

variables.name: WEBUI_SECRET_KEY
variables.label: Session secret
variables.description: Signs the sign-in sessions; generated when left empty

variables.name: OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH
variables.label: Context length
variables.description: How much of a conversation a model keeps in mind, in tokens (8192 suits a 12 GB card; 16384 or more on 16 GB)
